svg.text: 1. HOUSING 1.2 STEEL, LASER CUT, FOLDED, POWDER COAT. TRAY 1.0 STEEL. 300 BALL-BEARING SLIDES.
2. OPENS ON A COMMAND FROM THE MERCHANT APP, A PULSE FROM ANY PRINTER ON RJ12, OR THE KEY.
3. A SWITCH REPORTS IT SHUT; EVERY OPEN IS LOGGED TO A STAFF PIN. PANELS AND INSERT: CLR-HW-702.
A TYPICAL DRAWER IS 410 × 415 × 110. THIS ONE IS 64 TALL.
